task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find out the number of ways of painting the fence such that at most 2 adjacent posts have the same color for the given fence with n posts and k colors.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method CountWaysToPaintFence(n: int, k: int) returns (count: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned count represents the total number of ways to paint the fence with n posts using k colors
- No more than two adjacent posts have the same color in any valid painting arrangement
